verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is a consumer GPU that can be locally deployed with ROCm to run PyTorch, vLLM, Llama.cpp, and SGLang, effectively enabling self-hosting of AI inference/training workloads via Docker or pip installs, and AMD explicitly frames this as a private alternative to cloud services. However, this is self-hosting of AI frameworks/models on the hardware, not the 'core product' itself (which is a physical GPU, not a hostable service), and support is via third-party open-source tools rather than a first-party self-hostable application. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of self-hosting workflows succeeding on this exact GPU, clarity on what 'self-hosting the core product' even means for a hardware SKU, first-party benchmarks confirming stability outside claimed docs.
